changes: Updated Koala core command gating so session_brief is always available, changed REVIEW gate logic to use active opt-in reviewers, and hardened DONE worktree cleanup so global @koala-agent/core links are repaired or cleanup is blocked before deleting the worktree.
usage: Run koala session_brief from any story phase for recovery; run koala reviewer_list to see active REVIEW reviewers; DONE cleanup automatically protects global koala links created by npm link.
limitations: No browser UI applies to this CLI workflow story; validate.ts remains optional and project command discovery is used when it is absent.
pitfalls: Rewriting story commits made verification evidence stale, so evidence had to be re-recorded at the current HEAD before TEST; reviewer clean findings must use valid categories such as happy, not clean.
